---
name: commit-message
description: Guidelines for writing clear and consistent commit messages in the project.

- When increasing version, use this format: `chore: bump version to x.y.z` (e.g. `chore: bump version to 0.8.12`)
- IMPORTANT: When recommending 'bump version', don't add anything else to commit message, just the version bump. This is to keep the commit history clean and focused on actual code changes, and to avoid confusion about what the commit contains. The version bump commit should be a clear marker of a new release, without any additional context or information that might distract from its purpose.
